purpose: Shared helpers for enum-safe admin SKU, tag, and badge values.
businessRules: SKU, asset tags, and product badge/tag values must normalize to uppercase with only A-Z, 0-9, hyphen, and underscore.
Admin-managed asset tags have a shared 40-character maximum and 16-tag maximum matching the SHRESTA-BE media_assets.tags contract.
Server actions must validate enum-like submitted values before creating backend change requests.
Customer-facing components may convert enum values back into readable labels without changing backend truth.
